# 1. Select variable
```{r}

rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))
library(tidyverse)

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

df_org <- readRDS(file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "all_data_merged_dummy.rds"))

all_variables <- names(df_org)
analysis_vars <- all_variables[grepl("^[a-zA-Z]{2}_.*_Yes$", all_variables)]

analysis_vars <- c(analysis_vars, "juntos_participation", "dm_altitude_high", "dm_altitude_low", "dm_altitude_mid",
                   "dm_house_crowding3")

attr(df_org$nt_ch_haz, "label")

df_label <- data_frame()
for (var in analysis_vars) {
  label <- attr(df_org[[var]], "label")
  temp_df <- data_frame(variable = var, label = label)
  df_label <- bind_rows(df_label, temp_df)
}

write_csv(df_label, file.path(gdrive_dir, "output", "analysis_vars.csv"))


```
